description: Use this when the user wants to stop a letter they created here: cancels a draft, or a paid letter that has not gone into production yet, and returns the amount to the user's credit. Letters already printed or posted cannot be recalled. This cancels our letter, not a contract the user has with someone else (for that, compose_letter writes the cancellation letter). Ask the user before cancelling. Needs the user's account.

letter_id.description: letter_id of the letter to cancel, from create_letter, compose_letter or list_letters, e.g. ltr_8f3k2m9q4x7v1c6b0n5p. Only drafts and paid letters not yet in production can be cancelled.

name: cancel_letter
title: Cancel letter
